_doc: Start cue of every shot in the brief's shot list (O01-O24, rev 116); a shot ends where the next starts. Cues (scripts/shot_times.py): 'Section|line|word' = that word's start in timing/timing_map.json (indices from 0, as in lyrics/as_sung.txt); 'end:'/'mid:' its end or middle; 't:<s>' a song time; 'event:<name>' an event in the timing map ('event:claps:<i>' the i-th clap); 'hey:Section|line' / 'echo:Section|line' the backing Hey! or echo after that line; 'bars_before:<ID>:<n>' / 'beats_after:<ID or cue>:<n>' n bars or beats from the beat nearest that time; 'pre'/'post' for shots before or after the music. 'snap': 'downbeat' or 'beat' moves the start onto the nearest one within max_snap_s (default 0.45 s for a downbeat, 0.3 s for a beat), only inside the grid's reliable spans. 'marks': timed events inside a shot, same cue syntax, for the animatic and the Remotion compositions. Times are song time (the master); video time = song time + lead_in_s.
_lead_in_why: The opening bookend (O01) plays before the song; the click on play is the cut to O02 at song time 0. Proposed 8.4 s = 252 frames = 14 beats of 18 frames: the outage-report spike 2.4 s (4 beats), the two real screenshots 2.4 s together (the brief caps them at 3 s), the recreated #it-self-help post 3.6 s (the two strike-throughs, the cursor, the click on play). The Remotion placeholder is 8.2 s (2.0 + 2.6 + 3.6). The song's own grid, extended back, has a beat at 0.06 s, so the bookend's beats run into the song's to within 60 ms. The master opens with 1.09 s of silence after the click (first sound 1.09 s, first beat 1.26 s).

post_roll._why: After the music (239.58 s; last sound 239.35 s). O24 is the end card then 'Next incident: TBD' (brief); the fact card is 'after O24' in the brief's Bookends section, while the Remotion end sequence (production log 6) runs disclosure, fact card, end card, final card. Lengths proposed: reading time at about 3 words a second.

remotion._why: Recommended values for remotion/src/config.ts (not changed here). BEAT = 18 frames at 30 fps is 0.600 s, 100.0 bpm. The drums track at 99.79 bpm up to stop 1 (0.6012 s a beat), 99.99 bpm from stop 1 to stop 2 (0.6000 s) and about 100.5 bpm in the outro, where the grid is loose. The 99.4 bpm from M0 was the 22 kHz, hop-256 tracker rounding to its 11.6 ms frames. So BEAT = 18 fits: a beat-locked loop drifts 3.7 frames per 100 beats before stop 1 and 0.1 frame after it. Start each beat-locked composition on its shot's start (every musical cut is on a beat) and, for shots longer than about 40 beats before stop 1 (O03, O09), take beat times from timing/timing_map.json instead of multiples of BEAT. DUR: replace the placeholders with these (seconds; frames in timing/shot_times.json).

overlays.note: The brief puts the disclosure 'after O16' (O15: 'Disclosure card follows'). A full-frame card there would stop the song for the ~25 s its 77 words need, so it's proposed as an overlay panel on O17's chorus (8 lines, about 18 s), off before 'Five-oh-three'. Repeated in the end sequence and the description.
